firm_data.firm_description: James F. Butler & Associates is a law firm specializing in auto claims, torts, slip & fall, and litigation management. James F. Butler is the Managing Attorney.
notable_facts: James F. Butler has over 35 years of experience.

email.subject: AI for James F. Butler & Associates, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi James,

With 35 years in the game, you know the pressure: auto claims and slip & fall litigation demand speed and precision, but lean teams can't match BigLaw's resources. That's where we come in.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in the Northeast to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your Jericho office on Thursday, April 10 to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
